hero.title: Design that pulls attention into focus.
hero.sub:
Flow Studio is a product design practice built around continuity—where intent, form, and experience bend together.
Minimal surface, dense thinking. Quiet visuals, heavy clarity.

concepts.name: Event Horizon Dock
concepts.desc: 將「插拔、擴充、收納」做成一個無干擾的連續動作，讓設備進入工作狀態像被重力拉入軌道。
